title: Imbalanced classes: resampling, class weights, and what the metric is hiding

videos.script: One subscriber in seventeen cancels. {{seventeen}} That makes churn a rare class, and the usual advice is to rebalance it. {{advice}} Weight the leavers. Copy them. Or throw stayers away until the two sides are even. {{remedies}} This lesson tries all three on the churn model and measures what each one buys. {{measure}} First, what rarity actually costs. A model needs enough leavers to learn from. {{count}} Their share of the rows turns out to matter much less. {{share}} Then the remedies. None of them makes the model know more. They move its chances, and with them the useful cut. {{move}} One of them, done in the wrong order, produces the best score in the course, and it is false. {{leak}} By the end, you know when rebalancing earns its place, and how to put the chances back afterwards. {{end}}
